Optional Ready-Made Gut Stacks
I don't think there's one universal supplement stack that heals everyone's gut, but the order you do things in does matter.

You fix the mechanics of digestion first (Phase 1), then reset your diet and motility (Phase 2), and you only move on to antimicrobial or anti-parasite protocols if you still have symptoms after that (Phase 3).

codex: The personal disclaimer leads smoothly into a three-part instructional sequence, giving the paragraph a polished roadmap rhythm. That construction can suggest AI editing, although none of these features establishes authorship.
haiku: The paragraph is evenly weighted and tidy, with every sentence built to the same parallel pattern and no concrete detail, anecdote or stake, so it reads as a summary of a framework rather than a writer's voice.
sonnet: The paragraph is a compact three-beat summary, with a framing sentence followed by one evenly paced sentence that runs through first, then, and finally with a label on each, so it reads like an outline turned into prose. It has no specific detail, aside, or personal reaction, and every clause is the same level of abstraction.
